Eugene is the kind of business owner you hope to find: knowledgeable, communicative, and completely fair. He takes the time to explain exactly what your car needs and why, without ever trying to upsell or push unnecessary services. I trust his advice 100%, and that peace of mind is priceless.

The attention to detail from the Splash Mobile team is on another level. They treat my vehicles like they were their own, and it shows in the results. From the quality of their work to their professionalism, they’ve earned my loyalty for life.

If you care about keeping your car in top shape and want to work with people who are honest, skilled, and dependable—look no further than Splash Mobile.

Huge shoutout to Eugene, who took time out of his July 4th holiday just to assess the full scope of what was needed. That kind of dedication is rare and says a lot about the level of service here.

And Diego—what an incredible job. He went above and beyond with the detail work, especially given how challenging some of the paint condition was. He didn’t take shortcuts and managed to restore the finish far better than I thought possible.

The interior now looks spotless, the paint has depth and shine again, and the Jeep feels like it’s been given a second chance. I’m genuinely impressed and grateful for the care they put into this job. Highly recommend this team if you want detailing done right.

I called Splash Mobile Detail, and Eugene walked me through all the options, as well as all the potential risks which I appreciated.  The seat is black leather with perforations, and has heating and cooling.  This is apparently not an easy seat to clean for this kind of mess!

reviews.author: Nicole Bertrand-Haydari
reviews.text:
Wow, what can’t I say about Splash Mobile Detail. First of all, I received this car in not the best state from the previous owner. The previous owner had smoked heavily in this car and left stains and ash all over the seats. As the new owner, and the neat freak that I am, I knew I had to get this car professionally cleaned. There was absolutely no way I could have done the job myself.

I requested a quote through Yelp and within minutes I received a quote from Eugene. When he gave me the quote, it was a bit above my price range but Eugene said he’d work with me and to give him a call in the morning. Boy, was I glad we talked it though. Eugene is the owner and is extremely knowledgeable about cleaning and taking good care of all vehicles. I explained to him everything I needed and he gave me an extremely fair price. What was even better was that he was able to fit me in that day and promised a 24 hour job.

Eugene and his team were extremely responsive and I knew I had left it in good hands. They did a complete ozone treatment to get the smoke out of the car, waxed the exterior and did a DEEP clean of the interior. Eugene called me that night and updated me on the process. He even recommended that I purchase a new air cabin filter to preserve and elongate the cleanliness of my new car.

The next day, Eugene and the team notified me that the car was ready. For such a big job, I was surprised that they were able to get it done in 24 hours. When I showed up to pick up my car, I couldn’t believe me eyes, it was like picking up a brand new car from the dealership.

My detailer, Danny, walked and talked me through the entire process and even showed me how to change my air cabin filter. After driving off, I received a call from Eugene asking me if I liked the job! TALK ABOUT CUSTOMER SERVICE. From the beginning the end, they showed me that they truly cared about the product they were delivering. He even said to come back to them in about 6 months to get rewaxed, which I certainly will because of how happy and impressed I am with there work.

All in all, 10/10 experience!
reviews.ownerResponse:
Well...I just read this.
Nicole, your officially the new marketing director at Splash, I quit!
Thank you. Thank you. Thank you!
Your review “IS” what Splash is all about:)

reviews.text: Trevor & Dustin did a great job on my 2013 BMW X3.  The exterior and interior needed some freshening up and the entire vehicle looked nearly new when they were done!  Owner Eugene was also a pleasure to work with on the price quote and appointment.  No surprises.  Very ethical and transparent all around and everyone exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend Splash Mobile Detail.  Thanks!
reviews.ownerResponse: Hey Abe! I’m thinking the X3 needs a refresher...let’s get her the care she loves, plus, who doesn’t like working for Abe!

reviews.author: Gloria Bokenkamp
reviews.text: These guys are great! And it's so great to see young entrepreneurs at work! Trevor and Dustin worked tirelessly on my 2016 Jeep Cherokee and added me to their Saturday schedule at the last minute. PLUS they came to my house, so I didn't have to sit and wait somewhere or make arrangements to leave my car. They were polite, respectful and hardworking and did an incredible job! I've never had a car detailed before, and will always use Splash Mobile Detail in the future. I HIGHLY recommend them!
